ayahs.arabic: وَأَوْحَيْنَا إِلَىٰ أُمِّ مُوسَىٰ أَنْ أَرْضِعِيهِ ۖ فَإِذَا خِفْتِ عَلَيْهِ فَأَلْقِيهِ فِي الْيَمِّ
ayahs.translation_en: And We inspired to the mother of Musa, 'Suckle him; but when you fear for him, cast him into the river.'

ayahs.arabic: فَالْتَقَطَهُ آلُ فِرْعَوْنَ لِيَكُونَ لَهُمْ عَدُوًّا وَحَزَنًا
ayahs.translation_en: And the family of Pharaoh picked him up, that he might be to them an enemy and a cause of grief.

ayahs.arabic: وَقَالَتِ امْرَأَتُ فِرْعَوْنَ قُرَّتُ عَيْنٍ لِّي وَلَكَ ۖ لَا تَقْتُلُوهُ
ayahs.translation_en: And the wife of Pharaoh said, 'A comfort of the eye for me and for you. Do not kill him.'

ayahs.arabic: فَلَمَّا أَتَاهَا نُودِيَ يَا مُوسَىٰ
ayahs.translation_en: And when he came to it, he was called, 'O Musa.'

ayahs.arabic: إِنِّي أَنَا رَبُّكَ فَاخْلَعْ نَعْلَيْكَ ۖ إِنَّكَ بِالْوَادِ الْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى
ayahs.translation_en: 'Indeed, I am your Lord, so remove your sandals. Indeed, you are in the sacred valley of Tuwa.'

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّنِي أَنَا اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنَا فَاعْبُدْنِي وَأَقِمِ الصَّلَاةَ لِذِكْرِي
ayahs.translation_en: 'Indeed, I am Allah. There is no deity except Me, so worship Me and establish prayer for My remembrance.'

ayahs.arabic: اذْهَبْ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُ طَغَىٰ
ayahs.translation_en: 'Go to Pharaoh; indeed, he has transgressed.'

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي
ayahs.translation_en: He said, 'My Lord, expand for me my chest.'

ayahs.arabic: وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي
ayahs.translation_en: 'And ease for me my task.'

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ لَا تَخَافَا إِنَّنِي مَعَكُمَا أَسْمَعُ وَأَرَىٰ
ayahs.translation_en: He said, 'Do not fear. Indeed, I am with you both; I hear and I see.'

ayahs.arabic: فَأْتِيَاهُ فَقُولَا إِنَّا رَسُولَا رَبِّكَ فَأَرْسِلْ مَعَنَا بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ وَلَا تُعَذِّبْهُمْ
ayahs.translation_en: So go to him and say, 'Indeed, we are messengers of your Lord, so send with us the Children of Israel and do not torment them.'

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا تِلْكَ بِيَمِينِكَ يَا مُوسَىٰ
ayahs.translation_en: And what is that in your right hand, O Musa?

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ هِيَ عَصَايَ أَتَوَكَّأُ عَلَيْهَا وَأَهُشُّ بِهَا عَلَىٰ غَنَمِي
ayahs.translation_en: He said, 'It is my staff; I lean upon it, and I bring down leaves for my sheep.'

ayahs.arabic: فَأَلْقَاهَا فَإِذَا هِيَ حَيَّةٌ تَسْعَىٰ
ayahs.translation_en: So he threw it down, and thereupon it was a snake, moving swiftly.

ayahs.arabic: وَاضْمُمْ يَدَكَ إِلَىٰ جَنَاحِكَ تَخْرُجْ بَيْضَاءَ مِنْ غَيْرِ سُوءٍ
ayahs.translation_en: 'And draw your hand into your side; it will come out white, without disease.'

ayahs.arabic: فَأَوْحَيْنَا إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ أَنِ اضْرِب بِّعَصَاكَ الْبَحْرَ ۖ فَانفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرْقٍ كَالطَّوْدِ الْعَظِيمِ
ayahs.translation_en: Then We inspired to Musa, 'Strike with your staff the sea,' and it parted, and each portion was like a great towering mountain.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَزْلَفْنَا ثَمَّ الْآخَرِينَ
ayahs.translation_en: And We advanced thereto the others.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنجَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَمَن مَّعَهُ أَجْمَعِينَ
ayahs.translation_en: And We saved Musa and those with him, all together.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَمَّا جَاءَ مُوسَىٰ لِمِيقَاتِنَا وَكَلَّمَهُ رَبُّهُ قَالَ رَبِّ أَرِنِي أَنظُرْ إِلَيْكَ
ayahs.translation_en: And when Musa came to Our appointment and his Lord spoke to him, he said, 'My Lord, show me Yourself that I may look at You.'

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ لَن تَرَانِي وَلَٰكِنِ انظُرْ إِلَى الْجَبَلِ فَإِنِ اسْتَقَرَّ مَكَانَهُ فَسَوْفَ تَرَانِي
ayahs.translation_en: He said, 'You will not see Me, but look at the mountain; if it remains in place, then you will see Me.'

ayahs.arabic: فَلَمَّا تَجَلَّىٰ رَبُّهُ لِلْجَبَلِ جَعَلَهُ دَكًّا وَخَرَّ مُوسَىٰ صَعِقًا
ayahs.translation_en: And when his Lord revealed Himself to the mountain, He made it crumble, and Musa fell down unconscious.
